verdict.rationale: MX exposes a documented Platform API with OpenAPI spec (available via GitHub and Postman import), REST endpoints across account verification, aggregation, statements, and webhooks, plus llms.txt and an MCP endpoint enabling AI-native access. Missing for 10: the official openapi.json isn't directly hosted at expected docs.mx.com paths (probe 404s), and there's no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond MX's own docs.
